hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */global/agents/*.md|*/global/agents/*/*.md) lines=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ "$lines" -gt 120 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"Agent %s has %d lines (max 120). Consider trimming filler.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"The agent file exceeds the 120-line limit defined in CLAUDE.md. Review and trim."}}' "$(basename "$f")" "$lines"; fi ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
